sources.summary: Rapping in Spanish used to be a hard sell to Britons – but the Puerto Rican star is making the Latin American community visible At the Seven Sisters Latin Village in north London, construction is under way. The market, which has become a centre for the British Latino community and has fought off a long battle against redevelopment , is paying homage to the biggest Latino star on the planet: Bad Bunny (real name Benito Martínez Ocasio). Continue reading...
